documents:
task: I found a lost pet
category: animal care
place_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society
address: 1925 Old Louisville Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-783-9404
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: people who found a stray dog or cat
what_to_do: Call the Humane Society before transporting the animal. Ask about intake, microchip scanning, photos, and what to do after hours.
what_to_bring: photo of pet, found location, leash or carrier if safe, your contact info
local_reality: Do not put yourself in danger catching an animal. Intake rules and capacity can change.
transportation_reality: Hard without a car, especially with an animal. You may need help transporting safely.
best_for: lost pet, found dog, found cat, microchip
warning: Call before bringing an animal. Emergency situations may require animal control or a vet.
keywords: found lost pet dog cat humane society animal shelter microchip
source_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society

task: I lost my pet
category: animal care
place_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society
address: 1925 Old Louisville Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-783-9404
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: pet owners missing a dog or cat
what_to_do: Call and check shelter reports. Post clear photos, last-seen location, collar or microchip details, and contact info.
what_to_bring: pet photo, microchip number, vet records if available
local_reality: Fast action matters. Check repeatedly because animals may arrive later.
transportation_reality: Hard without a car if you need to search multiple neighborhoods or visit shelters.
best_for: lost dog, lost cat, shelter check
warning: Avoid scams asking for money to return a pet.
keywords: lost pet dog cat humane society shelter microchip
source_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society

task: I need pet vaccines
category: animal care
place_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society
address: 1925 Old Louisville Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-783-9404
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: pet owners needing low-cost vaccines or basic care referrals
what_to_do: Check the Humane Society website or call about vaccine clinics, eligibility, prices, and appointment rules.
what_to_bring: pet records, leash or carrier, payment method
local_reality: Clinic dates and prices can change. Do not travel without confirming.
transportation_reality: Difficult without a car if carrying a pet carrier.
best_for: vaccines, pet care, low cost
warning: Verify clinic schedule and fees before going.
keywords: pet vaccine cat dog rabies clinic humane society
source_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society

task: I need spay/neuter
category: animal care
place_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society
address: 1925 Old Louisville Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-783-9404
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: pet owners seeking spay or neuter help
what_to_do: Call about current spay/neuter options, waitlists, fees, and required pre-visit instructions.
what_to_bring: pet records, leash or carrier, payment, fasting instructions if provided
local_reality: Spay/neuter usually requires scheduling and pickup timing. Plan both drop-off and return.
transportation_reality: Very hard without a car because surgery drop-off and pickup times are strict.
best_for: spay neuter, low-cost pet surgery
warning: Never miss pickup instructions after surgery.
keywords: spay neuter pet surgery cat dog humane society
source_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society

task: I need emergency animal help
category: animal care
place_name: Local emergency veterinarian
address: Call nearest emergency vet before traveling
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: pet owners with urgent animal medical needs
what_to_do: Call a veterinarian or emergency animal clinic immediately. NewBG demo data does not verify live emergency availability.
what_to_bring: pet, records if available, payment method
local_reality: Emergency animal care can be expensive and availability changes quickly.
transportation_reality: Usually requires a car or paid ride, especially after hours.
best_for: animal emergency, injured pet
warning: If a person is in danger, call 911. For animal medical emergencies, call a vet first.
keywords: emergency animal vet injured pet after hours
source_name: NewBG demo data

task: I want to adopt a pet
category: animal care
place_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society
address: 1925 Old Louisville Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-783-9404
website: https://www.bgwchsky.org
who_it_helps: people wanting to adopt dogs or cats
what_to_do: Check available pets and adoption rules online, then call or visit during adoption hours.
what_to_bring: ID, landlord approval if renting, payment, pet supplies plan
local_reality: Adoption is a real commitment. Budget for food, vaccines, housing rules, and transport.
transportation_reality: Possible only with reliable transport for visits, adoption day, and vet care.
best_for: adoption, dog, cat, humane society
warning: Renters should check pet policies before adopting.
keywords: adopt pet dog cat humane society shelter
source_name: BG/Warren County Humane Society

task: I need a dog-friendly park
category: animal care
place_name: Basil Griffin Park
address: 2055 Three Springs Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-842-5302
website: https://www.warrencountyky.gov/parks
who_it_helps: dog owners looking for outdoor space
what_to_do: Use parks with leash rules and dog-friendly areas. Bring water, bags, and check posted rules.
what_to_bring: leash, waste bags, water, vaccine tag if available
local_reality: Dog-friendly does not mean off-leash everywhere. Follow posted rules.
transportation_reality: Most larger parks are easier with a car, especially with pets and supplies.
best_for: dog park, pet friendly, walking
warning: Verify current park pet rules before going.
keywords: dog friendly park pet walking basil griffin
source_name: Warren County Parks
